evidence_gate.formal_expansion: Only a complete pass on Rollo4A authorizes a frozen six-roll confirmation. No selector quantile, score mode, stage-one view, or tie rule may be changed after reading Rollo4A metrics.

adjacent_work: Dynamic Tiling (arXiv:2309.11069) starts from non-overlapping object-detection tiles and adapts overlap
HiAD (arXiv:2508.12931) assigns detectors from a pool under high-resolution compute constraints

novelty_boundary.candidate_difference: The decision unit is an optional crop observation of an already registered physical parent coordinate. Source-normal calibrated first-stage evidence assigns value to a third crop-context observation, and a same-count uniform control isolates placement value from compute budget.
